abstract: Borrelia has a linear chromosome and linear plasmids capped by hairpin telomeres that short-read sequencing cannot resolve. Here, we present a protocol for telomere-to-telomere assembly of Borrelia genomes. We describe steps for spanning B. burgdorferi culture, DNA extraction, and sequencing through hybrid genome assembly to generate complete Borrelia genomes. The pipeline integrates Oxford Nanopore long reads and Illumina short reads to assemble hairpin telomeres, resolve paralogous linear and circular plasmids, and annotate and validate the assembled complete Borrelia genome. For complete details on the use and execution of this protocol, please refer to Amin et al.1.
